elena: launching now. @raj @maya please watch metrics and smoke id smoke-378. I'll pin the release notes after traffic at 25% :rocket:

raj: on it. starting smoke & latency checks. running: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=5m` and smoke script `./smoke.sh smoke-378`

maya: QA smoke kicked off against canary. will post PASS/FAIL. FYI reranker tests are flaky in CI but nothing in this change set touches reranker models.

raj: smoke ok (smoke-378). no 5xx, errors 0/120 (last 5m). p50=45ms p95=190ms. tail shows no ERROR entries.

deploybot: Traffic shift to 25% complete. continuing to next stages. current quick metrics: error_rate=0.02% p95=185ms.

elena: good to continue. pinning the release tag after full traffic. will monitor dashboards for the next 20m.

raj: observing background pod churn small but within expected. I see one short GC spike on runtime-3, no requests dropped.

maya: QA: smoke-378 PASS :white_check_mark: all sanity checks green (auth, inference, streaming).

deploybot: Production deploy completed
tag: release/v3.6.0
commit: 9f8a7b6
status: success
traffic: 100%
notes: observability dashboard https://telemetry.redwood.internal/dashboards/deploy/9f8a7b6 ; rollout pinned to tag release/v3.6.0

raj: verified infra health and alerting. no regressions in latencies or error rates.

elena: thanks team :tada: I'll publish the release summary and add a brief rollback playbook to the release notes.

deploybot: reminder: If any post-release anomalies appear, use `ops runbook deploy-rollback` and @oncall will be notified automatically.
